title: Home practical guide and safety card: walking speed
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 48 (Home practical guide and safety card: walking speed (portal worksheet; indoors or a garden, never near roads))
intro: Lesson 48: Forces in action: speed and stopping. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Indoors or in a garden, never near roads

questions.q: Big question: why is 30 mph near a school safer than 40 mph?
questions.a: The stopping distance is much shorter (23 m against 36 m).
